statements.status_notes: GO-2026-5932 covers the golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package, which upstream declares unmaintained and unsafe by design with no fixed version. The package enters the image through github.com/sigstore/rekor and helm.sh/helm/v3/pkg/provenance. Rekor v1.5.4 and later no longer import it. Source-controller builds of the 1.6 and 1.7 lines that use rekor v1.5.4 contain no golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp symbols, and the current 1.9 and 1.10 builds contain none either. Earlier published 1.6 builds still include the package (openpgp@v0.1.0-deprecated in the SBOM), so this statement stays under investigation until the rebuilt 1.6 and 1.7 images are published and the finding is confirmed on them. No patched golang.org/x/crypto release exists for the openpgp package.
